map.根据镜片厚度与材料，推荐磨边类型、尖边位置与角度规格: Recommend the edging type, bevel position and angle specification from the lens thickness and material
map.📖 查看「磨边规格器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Edging Specification Tool User Guide"
map.镜片边缘形式按镜架类型选择：全框沟槽边、半框（拉丝边）、无框平边加倒角抛光、尼龙: The lens edge form is chosen by frame type: full-rim grooved edge, half-rim (nylor), rimless flat edge with chamfer and polish, nylon frame grooved; the edge form, position and angle are determined by lens thickness and material.
map.V形，嵌入镜框沟槽: V-shaped, fitting into the frame groove
map.开槽嵌尼龙丝: Grooved to hold the nylor cord
map.薄镜片避免尖边破裂: Avoid bevel cracking in thin lenses
map.厚镜片前移减少边缘突出: Forward shift for thick lenses to reduce edge protrusion
map.厚镜片需宽尖边防松动: Thick lenses need a wide bevel to prevent looseness
map.尖边位置\"前移\"指尖边顶点偏向镜片前表面，使后表面保留更多材料，减少镜片从镜:
Bevel position "forward" means the bevel apex leans toward the lens front surface, keeping more material at the back surface and reducing the aesthetic problem of the lens protruding from behind the frame.
      Rimless lenses use a flat edge + chamfer + polish; nylor half-rims use a grooved edge (groove width about 0.6-0.8 mm).
map.磨边规格受镜框沟槽形状与设备影响，实际参数请结合加工设备与镜框规格书确定。: Edging specifications are affected by the frame groove shape and equipment; determine actual parameters with your processing equipment and frame specification sheet.
map.按镜片中心/边缘厚度选尖边角度与位置。: Choose the bevel angle and position by the lens center/edge thickness.
map.厚镜片前移尖边减外凸。: Forward-shift the bevel of thick lenses to reduce outward bulge.
map.中心厚 2.5mm → 标准尖边 30–35° 居中；4mm → 35–40°: Center thickness 2.5 mm → standard bevel 30-35° centered; 4 mm → 35-40° forward 1/3; 6 mm → 40-45° forward 1/3; >8 mm custom + polish.
map.高度数凹透镜边缘厚，尖边前移 1/3 使镜片更贴脸、减外张，美观且减像跳。: High-power concave lenses have thick edges; shifting the bevel forward 1/3 makes the lens hug the face more, reduces outward splay, improves aesthetics and reduces image jump.
map.尖边角度越大越好？: Is a larger bevel angle better?
map.否。角度随厚度增是为包住厚边，过尖易崩边，薄片用平边即可。: No. The angle increases with thickness to wrap the thick edge, but too sharp easily chips the edge; thin lenses can use a flat edge.
map.合理尖边增边缘抱合力、防脱框；过度打磨减薄会降强度，需按厚度匹配。: A reasonable bevel increases edge grip and prevents the lens from leaving the frame; excessive grinding thins the lens and reduces strength, so it must match the thickness.
map.根据镜片厚度与材料推荐磨边类型、尖边位置与角度，辅助镜片磨边加工规格选择。: Recommend the edging type, bevel position and angle from the lens thickness and material, supporting lens edging specification selection.
